name: Northern Trust Short-Term Tax-Exempt Bond ETF
name_en: Northern Trust Short-Term Tax-Exempt Bond ETF
desc: The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market with maturities of less than five years as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
